_comment: The Shopfront Design Circuit, drawn on the map as a connected path.
The event itself has one venue cell — 'Various Locations, East End, ADL CBD'
— which is not a place and cannot be pinned. Its stops are named in the
program's contributors column, as 'business x designer' pairs. The business
half is the shopfront you walk to, so that is what is listed here.
THE ORDER OF THIS LIST IS THE ORDER OF THE WALK. It started as the order
the contributors column happens to be in, which is not necessarily the
route anyone would walk. Reorder these freely — the line on the map
follows this list and nothing else.
Coordinates come from src/_data/venues.json, the same file the venue pins
Each stop has an "address" — fill it in and the pin is exact. Empty, the shop name is geocoded instead, which for a small East End business usually means a guess at the middle of the city.
title: SHOPFRONT DESIGN CIRCUIT
eventVenue: Various Locations, East End, ADL CBD
